name: research
description: Investigate questions and produce evidence-backed findings. Load for research, web search, fact-checking, comparisons, sources, citations or current information.

content.inline:
# Research

Establish the actual question, relevant time window and decision the answer will
support. When current or external evidence is needed, load the **http** child to
search public sources, fetch pages or query web APIs. If no external tool is
available, say what evidence is missing instead of presenting recollection as
verification.

Prefer primary, authoritative sources. Cross-check consequential or disputed
claims, distinguish sourced fact from inference, and keep links or citations next
to the claims they support. Note material uncertainty and disagreement without
hiding behind an undifferentiated list of caveats.

Lead with the finding, then the evidence and implications.
